data.comment:
# Comfy LTX-2.5 (Pro)- Image to Video

Generate video from a single image using LTX-2.5's fast distilled model, delivering cinematic multi-shot sequences with consistent characters, lighting, and style across cuts. The workflow outputs a video file with native multishot support and automatic duration prediction. Ideal for rapid storyboarding, social media content creation, and pre-visualization in commercial production pipelines. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_ltx2_5_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. EPIC WIDE SHOT: a line of warships exchanges heavy fire with an enemy fleet in high orbit, massive beams of light crossing between the formations, each hit blooming into a burst of fire on the hulls, debris drifting between the ships. The ships fire in sequence, one beam after another, hull lights flashing along the battle line. The camera drifts slowly along the formation, passing the firing ships, their cannons glowing white-hot between shots. Deep resonant beam hums, rolling detonations through the void, the low rumble of the ships, a sustained combat tone. The camera pulls back to show the full line of ships locked in battle against the enemy fleet. No text, no black frames.
